_readme: Copy to settings.json next to HARDLIGHT.exe (or in %APPDATA%/HARDLIGHT). All keys are optional.
_focus: Focus time (offline practice only; never in online duels): world speed while the ring console is open (1 = off, e.g. 0.35) and seconds of slow time in a full meter.

system2._readme: Optional stronger interpreter. 'off' | 'anthropic' | 'openai-compatible'. Without it, the offline rule system is used.
